items.title: People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27 begins
items.text: Special Gram Sabhas across India are marking 2 October with discussions on governance reforms and the launch of the People’s Plan Campaign 2026-27, Sabki Yojana, Sabka Vikas.

items.title: UPSC completes 100 years
items.text: The Public Service Commission was established on 1 October 1926. UPSC has marked its centenary with events focused on public service, examination reforms and technology.
items.source: Press Information Bureau / Indian Express, Oct 2026

items.title: Asian Games 2026 continues in Aichi-Nagoya
items.text: Indian athletes are continuing their campaign at the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, with competitions across multiple disciplines on 2 October.

items.title: Indigenous carbon-fibre technology highlighted
items.text: CSIR has unveiled indigenous carbon-fibre manufacturing technology aimed at reducing import dependence for high-performance applications.

items.title: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 discussed
items.text: Special Gram Sabha discussions on 2 October include awareness of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 as part of cleanliness and local governance initiatives.
